title: Request for Donation Improvements
line: The yearly donation notification now has a link to see what past donations made possible.
explanation: The December donation notification only said that KDE needs help and offered Donate… and No Thanks, with nothing showing what donations actually achieve, which is the main point of the wish ("What do my donations do?"). Any button closes the notification and suppresses it for the year, so a plain extra action would also have hidden the Donate option. The notification text now ends with a "See what past donations made possible" link to https://ev.kde.org/reports/; Plasma's notifications open body links in the browser without closing the notification.

commits.message:
donationmessage: link to what past donations made possible

The yearly donation notification asked for money without showing what
it pays for. Add a link to KDE e.V.'s reports in its text, which opens
in the browser and leaves the notification up so you can still donate.

BUG: 492379

media.caption: Before: the donation notification only asks for money.
After: a link shows what past donations made possible; clicking it opens ev.kde.org/reports and the notification stays up.
